text:
I came to get a molar filling because my 30-year-old filling had cracked and fallen out. I called ahead for an appointment on Tuesday at 2 PM, and there were no appointments. The receptionist greeted me, and the housekeeper and security guard helped direct traffic onto the main road. The service was excellent, and I waited about 10 minutes for my dental work.

Dr. Suphawit Tasanamethi was meticulous, examining the cavity beneath the filling and removing the remaining filling for a complete new filling. The filling took only 20 minutes. My upper and lower teeth fit perfectly, with no protrusions. There was no discomfort or pain during the procedure, even though I was prepared for it. 😊 (Another reason, aside from the dentist's skill, might be because it wasn't too close to the nerves.) This time, I opted for a silver amalgam filling. It's not pretty, but it's durable and won't break easily.

The staff sucked up my saliva. They always sucked and took great care of me.

I had one filling on both sides for 2,150 baht. I used Social Security for 900 baht, so I actually paid 1,250 baht.

Thank you so much to the doctor and all the staff. I'm so impressed! 🥰

🍀🍀🍀🍀🍀🍀🍀
The reception area is spacious and modern. There are automatic massage chairs, Healthy Blue Boy soft drinks, water, snacks, and an automatic coffee machine for you to enjoy while you wait. The coffee has a good aroma, which speaks to its quality.

There's parking in front along the road for two spaces.
And further down the side alley, there's parking for several more cars in the back.
